title: QBE Insurance (Australia) Limited - proposed acquisition of Compusure Pty Limited's travel insurance distribution network

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: QBE Insurance (Australia) Ltd proposes to acquire the travel insurance distribution assets of Compusure Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the national market for the supply of general travel insurance.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 25 February 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition. Factors informing this conclusion included that barriers to entry appear to be relatively low and there are a high number of substitute suppliers which offer comparable substitutes to the merged entity.
